snippet.title: NEX WAR - Free Browser MMORPG Trailer | 100% Skillshot, Crafting & Full Loot PvP
snippet.description:
A free MMORPG playable in your browser, on PC and mobile. Every spell is aimed by hand, and every death has a price.

Pick 2 schools of magic out of 7, choose from 77 spells, no classes, no levels. Kill, gather, refine, craft, equip and trade: all gear is made by players, and gold is an item you can lose.

T1 is safe PvE. T2 turns PvP on and you drop your bag. T3 is full loot. Plus a ranked 1v1 arena and a PvPvE extraction dungeon.

Skill over gear. No pay-to-win. No download. Now in Alpha.

▶ Play now: https://nexwar.io
💬 Discord: https://discord.com/invite/CjqAZg6SyP
🎮 itch.io: https://evodotexe.itch.io/nex-war

#mmorpg #indiegame #browsergame
